vision.sign_in_needed_text: To talk to the Vision service the page needs you to sign in with your name and PIN. The service is not off.
vision.the_camera_is_not_calibrated_without: The camera is not calibrated: without calibration there are no measurements. Go to Calibrate.
vision.no_part_was_found_try_detect: No part was found. Try Detect and measure > Detection settings, or mark a Zone on the image.
vision.for_the_measuring_photo_use_the: For the measuring photo, use the card below.
vision.cut_area_zone_origin_to_the: Cut area, zone origin, to the laser editor, save it in the library...
vision.if_there_are_several_the_one: If there are several, the one you want to use.
vision.tap_the_part_in_the_image: Tap the part in the image
vision.finds_the_outline_of_the_part: Finds the outline of the part and its holes.
vision.a_measuring_photo_the_camera_positions: A measuring photo (the camera positions itself to see the whole part, more accurate) or the video as it is.
vision.lay_it_flat_with_the_bed: Lay it flat with the bed clear around it. If the camera is not calibrated, go through Calibrate first.
vision.put_the_material_on_the_bed: Put the material on the bed
vision.marks_in_the_video_where_the: Marks in the video where the head is, where the laser hits and, if you want, where the BLTouch touches, with its path.
vision.tap_a_part_in_the_image: Tap a part in the image and then Track: it shows how much it moved and rotated since that moment (for example if the clamping loosens during a job) and draws its path.
vision.shows_or_hides_the_measurements_drawn: Shows or hides the measurements drawn on the part.
vision.analyzes_the_video_nonstop_about_once: Analyzes the video nonstop (about once per second) and draws the dimensions of the part and its holes on top.
vision.it_s_recognized_by_its_measurements: It's recognized by its measurements (length, width, area, perimeter and number of holes), anywhere and at any rotation. They're saved on the SD card (sys/workshop/data/vision-parts.json).
vision.deletes_this_part_from_the_library: Deletes this part from the library. Asks for a second tap.
vision.there_are_no_saved_parts_yet: There are no saved parts yet.
vision.recognize_them_by_themselves_in_the: Recognize them by themselves in the image (★ name)
vision.analyze_the_image_and_tap_a: Analyze the image and tap a part (or a rectangle) to choose it. Its shape and measurements are saved; afterwards, every time it appears in the image, it's marked with its name.
vision.without_calibration_there_are_no: Without calibration there are no measurements to save.
vision.shape_ready_the_workbench_laser_editor: Shape ready: the Workbench laser editor opens.
vision.aligned_with_the_calibration_here_and: Aligned with the calibration here and follows the gantry in Y and Z. In Zones, the map's Camera layer shows or hides it. It needs to be calibrated.
vision.the_video_shows_under_the_map: The video shows under the map
vision.saved_if_it_is_another_camera: Saved. If it is another camera, calibrate again.
vision.only_what_was_off_is_turned: Only what was off is turned on, and at the end only that is turned off. In a mosaic the light stays on between photos. It also applies to the calibration with crosses.
vision.couldn_t_read_the_lights_and: Couldn't read the Lights and status zones (workshop service off?).
vision.extra_zones_turned_on_only_for: Extra zones turned on only for the photo:
vision.there_are_no_extra_light_zones: There are no extra light zones. If you add one on the Lights and status page (for example a strip next to the camera), it shows up here to turn it on only during the photo.
vision.reading_the_lights_and_status_zones: Reading the Lights and status zones...
vision.the_surveillance_video_stays_automatic_i: The surveillance video stays automatic: it only changes while the photo is taken.
vision.exposure_saved_it_applies_to_the: Exposure saved: it applies to the next photo.
vision.fixed_exposure_time_every_photo_comes: Fixed exposure time: every photo comes out the same (useful for mosaics or comparing). Without the usual light it may come out dark.
vision.automatic_with_a_fixed_level_darker: Automatic with a fixed level: darker for white or shiny material, brighter for dark MDF.
vision.automatic_but_it_checks_the_photo: Automatic, but it checks the photo: if it comes out burnt or dark it corrects and takes another (up to 3). The best option with white or shiny material.
vision.the_camera_decides_by_itself_as: The camera decides by itself, as in the video. If the photo comes out burnt or dark, the page warns you.
vision.calibration_is_per_resolution_if_you: Calibration is per resolution: if you change the measuring photo's resolution, calibrate again. The camera only switches to high resolution while taking the photo (a few seconds).
vision.on_the_gantry_the_image_follows: On the gantry the image follows Y and Z; X does not change what the camera sees.
vision.on_the_carriage_the_image_follows: On the carriage the image follows X, Y and Z: the photo plan also centers in X and in Work zones the Camera tool moves X and Y. The calibration stores X (old calibrations without X: calibrate again).
vision.on_the_carriage_the_image_follows_no_map: On the carriage the image follows X, Y and Z: the photo plan also centers in X. The calibration stores X (old calibrations without X: calibrate again).
vision.on_the_carriage_follows_x_y: On the carriage (follows X, Y and Z)
vision.on_the_gantry_follows_y_and: On the gantry (follows Y and Z)
vision.watches_for_2_minutes_without_a: Watches for 2 minutes WITHOUT a job, as if there was one: if it sees flame or smoke it alerts in Activity and on the phone (marked TEST). It never pauses or stops.
vision.measures_the_camera_image_now_without: Measures the camera image now, without a job and without acting: to see whether the camera sees the area well and what would count as a flame.
vision.with_this_image_it_would_see: With this image it would see a flame:
vision.latest_detections_and_pauses_with_the: Latest detections and pauses, with the reason
vision.high_warns_earlier_smaller_flame_less: High warns earlier (smaller flame, less time) but may be fooled by materials that glow when cut; low needs a bigger flame and more time.
vision.time_to_cancel_if_it_is: Time to cancel if it is a false smoke alarm (10 s by default). The detection must continue during the countdown: if it disappears, nothing happens.
vision.smoke_is_easier_to_mistake_than: Smoke is easier to mistake than flame (light changes, the camera moving with the head, plain materials): with No, smoke only warns and flame does trigger the action.
vision.with_smoke_only_no_flame_also_2: With smoke only (no flame) also stop:
vision.with_smoke_only_no_flame_also: With smoke only (no flame) also pause:
vision.it_is_a_real_fire_it: It is a real fire: it waits little. With a countdown you can cancel from the Cancel button that appears; Immediate acts as soon as the flame is seen, without waiting (the camera confirmation time, 1 to 3 s, still applies).
vision.it_only_logs_and_notifies_the: It only logs and notifies the phone; the job goes on.
vision.pause_m25_stops_a_file_job: Pause (M25) stops a file job. A live job (a program sending it line by line) cannot be paused from the Duet: in that case it only notifies.
vision.emergency_stop_m112_cuts_everything_at: Emergency stop (M112): cuts everything at once; afterwards the board must be reset and homed.
vision.it_s_an_aid_not_a: It's an aid, not a safety system: never leave the machine cutting alone, keep an extinguisher at hand and the lid closed with extraction. The camera may not see a fire that you do see.
vision.test_with_the_current_image_shows: Test with the current image: shows in red what would count as flame and how far it is from the threshold. Live test: watches for 2 minutes without a job and alerts (marked as TEST, it never pauses or stops). Tap it BEFORE lighting the candle: the first 3 seconds it takes the reference image. Then put a candle or a lighter on the bed, with the flame visible from above (not inside a glass).
vision.the_camera_looks_at_the_bed: The camera looks at the bed from above: it doesn't see a flame inside a glass or behind something, or out of the image. Nor a flame hidden by the head or by smoke, or very small and far; an ember without flame; thin smoke. With the camera calibrated it ignores the spot where the laser hits; without calibration, cutting materials that glow a lot can confuse it (lower the sensitivity).
vision.with_a_job_running_changing_the: With a job running, changing the action, the on/off switch, the sensitivity or the countdowns asks for the Understood checkbox and the service is told before saving; a change saved without confirming does not apply until the job ends.
vision.flame_very_bright_orange_or_yellow: Flame: very bright orange or yellow pixels, or a very bright white spot that was not there at the start (this camera often sees flames as white), larger than the laser spot and still there after a few seconds. Smoke: the image loses contrast (turns grey) across almost the whole picture, without getting darker, compared with what was seen 30 to 90 seconds earlier, and stays that way for several seconds (8 s at medium sensitivity).
vision.only_with_a_laser_job_running: Only with a LASER job running (Laser mode and a file or live job) and with the watch on. Outside a job it doesn't warn about anything, even if there is fire: to test it use Live test.
vision.read_it_before_relying_on_it: Read it before relying on it
vision.how_it_works_and_its_limits: How it works and its limits
vision.while_a_laser_job_runs_the: While a laser job runs, the camera looks at the bed about twice per second. If it sees a flame or dense smoke for a few seconds, it logs it in Activity, notifies the phone and, after a countdown that can be cancelled, does what you choose below.
vision.understood_i_want_to_change_it: Understood: I want to change it now
vision.a_laser_job_is_running_the: A laser job is running: the change applies from now on, for this job. The service is told before it is saved.
vision.height_saved_the_photo_plan_now: Height saved. The photo plan now picks the best Z.
vision.bad_fit_check_that_they_are: Bad fit: check that they are the same markers and that nothing moved.
vision.mark_4_points_on_the_new: Mark 4 points on the new photo (With points by hand section) with their X/Y.
vision.uses_the_aruco_markers_in_the: Uses the ArUco markers in the current photo and the saved calibration (at another Z).
vision.to_move_anyway_tap_go_to: . To move anyway, tap Go to Z again (double tap).
vision.enter_the_z_to_go_to: Enter the Z to go to.
vision.with_a_saved_calibration_1_raise: With a SAVED calibration: 1) raise or lower the gantry 50 mm or more (Go to Z). 2) Take photo here. 3) Calibrate height (with the same markers in view). With that the lens height is known and photos can be taken at any Z.
vision.so_the_photo_plan_picks_the: So the photo plan picks the best Z
vision.calibration_saved_it_now_measures_in: Calibration saved. It now measures in machine mm.
vision.very_high_check_the_coordinates_a: Very high: check the coordinates (a marker or point entered wrong?).
vision.4_complete_points_are_needed_tapped: 4 complete points are needed (tapped on the image and with X and Y).
vision.without_printing_anything_4_or_more: Without printing anything: 4 or more points far apart. For each one: pick it, tap it on the image and give it its coordinate (Pointer here: bring the pointer with the jog to a visible mark on the bed).
vision.4_or_more_points_tap_them: 4 or more points: tap them on the image and give them X/Y
vision.many_points_on_their_own_the: Many points on their own: the most accurate by hand; it also corrects the lens
vision.it_finds_the_sheet_on_its: It finds the sheet on its own; you give 3 corners with the pointer
vision.4_markers_with_x_and_y: 4 markers with X and Y are needed.
vision.uses_where_the_pointer_is_now: Uses where the POINTER is now (nothing moves).
vision.opens_a_sheet_with_the_markers: Opens a sheet with the markers at real size.
vision.1_print_the_markers_and_stick: 1) Print the markers and stick them firmly on the bed or table, near the corners of what the camera sees (do not cover them with material). 2) For each one, bring the POINTER to its center with the jog and tap Pointer here. 3) Calibrate now. Later, if the camera moves, only step 3.
vision.print_4_markers_stick_them_and: Print 4 markers, stick them and give their position
vision.burns_6_9_or_12_crosses: Burns 6, 9 or 12 crosses on a sheet and finds them on its own
vision.measure_something_of_known_size_a: Measure something of known size (a ruler, a part) in Detect and measure: the difference is the real error.
vision.to_measure_and_take_photos_at: To measure and take photos at any Z: calibrate again with the gantry 50 mm or more higher or lower. The laser crosses do it on their own.
vision.with_the_laser_crosses_the_easiest: With the laser: crosses (the easiest, nothing to print). Without laser: an A4 sheet (nothing to print) or a chessboard (the most accurate by hand, and it corrects the lens). Also ArUco markers or points by hand.
vision.the_camera_isn_t_sending_images: The camera isn't sending images: check that it's on and connected.
vision.the_camera_is_sending_video_it: The camera is sending video. It should look sharp and evenly lit (no strong shadows or reflections); if not, adjust it in Settings.
vision.it_is_calibrated_at_the_measuring: It is calibrated at the measuring photo resolution. The camera is on the gantry: Y and Z are taken into account automatically.
vision.measuring_photo_at_the_current_position: Measuring photo at the current position (does not move). Markers and hand points are calibrated on this photo.
vision.for_now_photos_are_taken_at: For now photos are taken at the calibration Z.
vision.measurements_come_out_only_in_pixels: Measurements come out only in pixels. Use one of the methods below.
vision.it_is_fixed_it_does_not: It is fixed: it does not follow Y/Z. Better to calibrate here.
vision.asks_for_a_second_tap_with: Asks for a second tap. With 'Already focused' it marks where the head is now.
vision.confirm_moves_and_fires_the_laser: Confirm: MOVES and FIRES the laser
vision.return_to_where_it_was_at: return to where it was at the end
vision.no_height_not_enough_crosses_seen: No height (not enough crosses seen below): photos go to the calibration Z.
vision.stops_after_the_current_step_if: Stops after the current step (if it is marking, cancel it in DWC too).
vision.while_it_marks_the_job_can: While it marks, the job can be paused or cancelled from DWC. Emergency stop: always.
vision.the_browser_blocked_the_print_window: The browser blocked the print window.
vision.the_image_is_corrected_from_now: The image is corrected from now on; the old calibrations no longer work and are deleted.
vision.lens_correction_saved_the_calibrations_w: Lens correction saved. The calibrations were deleted: calibrate again.
vision.high_add_photos_with_the_chessboard: (high: add photos with the chessboard closer to the edges)
vision.high_resolution_photo_without_the_curren: High resolution photo WITHOUT the current correction. It doesn't move the machine.
vision.taking_a_photo_of_the_chessboard: Taking a photo of the chessboard...
vision.take_4_to_8_photos_with: Take 4 to 8 photos with the chessboard in different places (center and corners of what the camera sees), Calculate and Save. Then calibrate again.
vision.no_correction_straight_lines_near_the: No correction: straight lines near the edges may look curved.
vision.x_and_y_homed_to_bring: X and Y homed (to bring the pointer to 3 corners)
vision.neither_the_camera_nor_the_board: Neither the camera nor the board moves until done
vision.whole_in_the_image_with_margin: Whole in the image, with margin at the edges
vision.flat_and_stuck_to_the_bed: Flat and stuck to the bed, no reflections or shadows
vision.columns_and_rows_squares_of_the: Columns and rows = SQUARES of the printed board (not corners), between 3 and 30
vision.i_measured_a_square_with_a: I measured a square with a ruler and entered that size below
vision.1_print_the_chessboard_at_100: 1) Print the chessboard at 100 % and measure one square with a ruler. 2) Stick it flat on the bed where the camera sees all of it. 3) Find the chessboard: it finds all the corners and numbers the outer ones 1 to 4. 4) Bring the POINTER to 3 of those corners (Pointer here on each). 5) Calculate.
vision.high_check_that_the_pointer_was: High: check that the pointer was right on each corner and that the sheet size is correct.
vision.corners_in_the_image_1_to: Corners in the image: 1 to 4 (orange = pointer missing, green = done).
vision.in_the_measuring_photo_if_there: In the measuring photo if there is one (more accurate), otherwise in the video.
vision.1_put_a_white_sheet_whole: 1) Put a white sheet, whole and flat, on the bed where the camera sees all of it (better on something dark, no shadows on it). 2) Find the sheet: its corners get numbers 1 to 4. 3) For 3 of them: bring the POINTER to the corner with the jog and tap Pointer here on that corner. 4) Calculate.
vision.saved_on_this_screen_look_at: Saved on this screen. Look at the Black/white view: the part must look white and whole.
vision.deletes_the_selected_template_this_scree: Deletes the selected template (this screen's settings do not change). Asks for a second tap.
vision.saves_these_detection_settings_with_the: Saves these detection settings with the material's name, to pick them next time.
vision.material_name_e_g_mdf_3: Material name (e.g. MDF 3 mm, clear acrylic):
vision.how_the_part_is_separated_sensitivity: How the part is separated, sensitivity, minimum sizes
vision.adds_it_to_saved_parts_afterwards: Adds it to Saved parts: afterwards it's recognized by itself when it appears in the image.
vision.the_outline_and_its_holes_in: The outline and its holes in an SVG in mm (works for your cutting software or another program).
vision.sends_the_outline_and_its_holes: Sends the outline (and its holes) to the Workbench laser editor, at its real place on the bed, to cut or engrave it.
vision.adds_it_to_the_offcuts_on: Adds it to the offcuts on the Zones map (the Laser editor tells whether the shapes fit).
vision.adds_the_center_to_the_jog: Adds the center to the jog's saved positions.
vision.saves_as_the_active_mode_s: Saves as the active mode's cutting area the rectangle that fits in this material, 2 mm inside the edge. Asks for a second tap.
vision.no_machine_mode: The mode of the machine is not known: without it the area cannot be saved for a mode.
vision.open_the_work_zones_page_the_2: Open the Work zones page: the point is already loaded.
vision.brings_the_pointer_to_the_bottom: Brings the POINTER to the bottom-left corner of the part.
vision.pointer_going_to_the_bottom_left: Pointer going to the bottom-left corner.
vision.tap_a_detection_here_or_on: Tap a detection (here or on the image) to see its actions. They also appear on the Zones map, Vision layer.
vision.downloads_a_table_csv_opens_in: Downloads a table (CSV, opens in Excel) with the part and each hole: machine position, position from the part's corner, diameter and roundness.
vision.draws_on_the_image_the_length: Draws on the image the length and width of the part and the distances between its holes (of the selected part, or the biggest one).
vision.the_camera_measures_on_the_plane: The camera measures on the plane of the bed. Something tall (a glass, a box) is closer to the lens and looks bigger: enter the height of the part you want to measure (for example the rim of the glass).
vision.the_camera_is_not_calibrated_detections: The camera is not calibrated: detections show but without mm or actions. Go to Calibrate.
vision.choose_what_to_look_for_under: Choose what to look for under the image and tap Analyze. Measurements in mm are MACHINE coordinates where the pointer lands (same as the Zones map).
vision.measuring_photo_where_the_machine_is: Measuring photo where the machine is now (does not move).
vision.works_out_where_to_put_the: Works out where to put the gantry (Y) and at what height (Z). Nothing moves.
vision.work_out_where_and_at_what: Work out where and at what height
vision.if_the_zone_has_no_material: If the zone has no material size:
vision.what_has_to_fit_in_the: What has to fit in the photo
vision.the_camera_is_on_the_gantry: The camera is on the gantry: Z goes up to see more (less detail) and Y centers it. The lowest Z that frames what was asked is chosen.
vision.deletes_the_map_background_photo_asks: Deletes the map background photo. Asks for a second tap.
vision.saves_this_photo_straightened_as_seen: Saves this photo, straightened as seen from above, as the background of the Zones and 2D work map. For the whole bed: choose Whole bed in What has to fit and take the mosaic.
vision.the_detections_below_are_from_this: The detections below are from this photo.
vision.the_machine_went_back_to_where: The machine went back to where it was.
vision.the_active_zone_has_no_material: the active zone has no material size: enter it below (width x height)
vision.fill_in_x0_y0_x1_y1: fill in X0 Y0 X1 Y1 of the rectangle
vision.nothing_visible_changed_between_the_two: Nothing visible changed between the two photos.
vision.compares_the_before_photo_with_the: Compares the before photo with the current image and marks in red what changed.
vision.saves_the_current_image_as_the: Saves the current image as the before photo (the machine position is recorded).
vision.1_before_cutting_with_the_camera: 1) Before cutting, with the camera looking at the part: Before photo. 2) After the cut, WITHOUT moving the camera: Compare. What changed shows in red: what was cut, what moved or what was left half-done. Useful to see at a glance whether a part was not fully cut.
vision.compares_the_bed_before_and_after_2: Compares the bed before and after cutting
vision.g68_rotates_the_coordinates_around_the: G68: rotates the coordinates around the ACTIVE zone's 0,0 (activate the zone with the new origin first). It affects everything sent afterwards, also from other programs. Asks for a second tap.
vision.opens_the_zone_editor_with_the: Opens the zone editor with the design's 0,0 as origin. You save it.
vision.open_the_work_zones_page_the: Open the Work zones page: the origin is already loaded.
vision.mark_b_in_the_design_y: Mark B in the design: Y
vision.mark_b_in_the_design_x: Mark B in the design: X
vision.mark_a_in_the_design_y: Mark A in the design: Y
vision.mark_a_in_the_design_x: Mark A in the design: X
vision.1_put_two_marks_circles_or: 1) Put two marks (circles or crosses) far apart in your design and note where they are. 2) Analyze the image, tap each detected mark and choose Mark A / Mark B in its actions. 3) Use the origin in Zones and, if the part is rotated, apply the rotation before cutting.
vision.aligns_the_design_with_2_marks_2: Aligns the design with 2 marks on an already printed or moved part and cuts on top
vision.the_two_design_marks_are_in: the two design marks are in the same place
vision.meanwhile_you_can_t_detect_or: Meanwhile you can't detect or calibrate. The Workbench map still shows the camera with the saved calibration.
vision.meanwhile_you_can_t_detect_or_no_map: Meanwhile you can't detect or calibrate.
vision.analyzes_the_image_again_looks_for: Analyzes the image again: looks for what is chosen in Find and measures.
vision.analyzes_the_video_continuously_about_on: Analyzes the video continuously (about once per second).
vision.marks_where_the_bltouch_probe_touches: Marks where the BLTouch probe TOUCHES the bed: the head plus the G31 offset of the active mode. It's the point of the bed below the probe; with the gantry high the probe itself looks shifted by perspective (it's close to the camera). If it touches somewhere else when probing, that mode's G31 offset is measured wrong.
vision.marks_on_the_image_where_the: Marks on the image where the head is (cross), where the laser hits (red dot) and its path over the last seconds (with Live the image updates by itself).
vision.what_to_look_for_in_the: What to look for in the image
vision.remove_the_zone_the_whole_image: Remove the zone: the whole image is analyzed again.
vision.requests_the_image_again_and_looks: Requests the image again (and looks for ArUco markers).
vision.pick_a_point_on_the_right: Pick a point on the right and tap it here
vision.real_time_video_analyzes_again_about: Real-time video: analyzes again about once per second.
vision.save_the_image_with_the_drawing: Save the image with the drawing (JPG)
vision.viewer_settings_on_this_screen_how: Viewer settings on this screen: how Vision starts and names on the buttons.
vision.ruler_in_machine_mm_on_the_2: Ruler in machine mm on the edges (needs calibration)
vision.ruler_in_machine_mm_on_the: Ruler in machine mm on the edges
vision.image_view_camera_edges_black_white: Image view: camera, edges, black/white or top-down, and rotate it as if standing in front of the machine.
vision.zoom_in_mouse_wheel_or_pinch: Zoom in (mouse wheel or pinch). With View, drag to move around the image.
vision.automatic_icons_only_if_that_way: Automatic: icons only if that way the bar fits in one row; if it does not fit either way, with names in two rows. Each button's explanation appears when you hold your finger or the mouse over it.
vision.with_a_photo_means_less_work: With a photo means less work for the system; Live analyzes again about once per second.
vision.rotate_as_in_front_of_the: Rotate as in front of the machine
vision.image_as_it_comes_from_the: Image as it comes from the camera. Tap to rotate it as if standing in front of the machine.
vision.image_rotated_as_if_standing_in: Image rotated as if standing in front of the machine (X to the right, Y toward the back). Tap to see it as it comes from the camera.
vision.rotate_as_if_standing_in_front: Rotate as if standing in front of the machine (needs calibration)
vision.moves_the_camera_arrows_more_area: Moves the camera: arrows, more area or more detail, or tap the image to center that point.
vision.drag_a_rectangle_only_the_inside: Drag a rectangle: only the inside is analyzed.
vision.several_points_area_and_perimeter_in: Several points: area and perimeter in mm. Tap the first one to close.
vision.two_points_distance_dx_dy_and: Two points: distance, dX, dY and angle in mm.
vision.tap_a_detection_to_see_its: Tap a detection to see its data and actions.
vision.tap_the_first_point_to_close: · tap the first point to close
vision.tap_two_points_on_the_image: Tap two points on the image
vision.without_calibration_it_isn_t_known: Without calibration it isn't known where that point is: use the arrows.
vision.tap_the_image_to_choose_what: Tap the image to choose what to center. Arrows: one step, with the laser off.
vision.safe_move_visionpose_g_raises_z: Safe move (visionpose.g): raises Z before moving, laser off, never below Z40; it doesn't move with a job running or without homing. Center and Back ask for a double tap.
vision.moves_the_camera_back_to_where: Moves the camera back to where it was before moving it from here.
vision.it_can_t_center_in_x: It can't center in X: the camera is on the gantry (it only follows Y and Z).
vision.moves_the_camera_so_that_point: Moves the camera so that point ends up in the center of the image.
vision.lowers_the_gantry_one_step_never: Lowers the gantry one step (never below Z40): more detail, it sees less bed.
vision.raises_the_gantry_one_step_the: Raises the gantry one step: the camera sees more bed, with less detail.
vision.not_calibrated_it_isn_t_known: Not calibrated: it isn't known how many mm it sees or how many mm per pixel.
vision.to_know_how_much_detail_you: To know how much detail you gain or lose by raising or lowering, calibrate the second height.
vision.drag_the_title_to_move_this: Drag the title to move this panel
vision.no_longer_used_in_work_zones: No longer used in Work zones.
vision.on_in_zones_tap_the_map: On: in Zones tap the map's Camera button to see it underneath.
vision.puts_this_camera_s_video_under: Puts this camera's video under the Work zones map, aligned with the calibration here (follows the gantry in Y and Z).
vision.this_needs_the_workbench_page: This needs the Workbench page (WorkshopWorkbench plugin), which is not installed or is deactivated.
vision.fire_and_smoke_where_the_camera: Fire and smoke, where the camera goes, exposure and light.
vision.so_the_image_is_measured_in: So the image is measured in machine mm.
vision.aligns_the_design_with_2_marks: Aligns the design with 2 marks on an already printed or moved part and cuts on top.
vision.compares_the_bed_before_and_after: Compares the bed before and after cutting.
vision.parts_library_recognizes_them_by_itself: Parts library: recognizes them by itself when they appear.
vision.dimensions_over_the_video_and_tracking: Dimensions over the video and tracking of a part and of the head.
vision.finds_parts_holes_circles_markers_and: Finds parts, holes, circles, markers... and measures in machine mm.
vision.from_the_bed_to_a_part: From the bed to a part ready to use, in 5 steps.
vision.auto_the_part_is_what_does: auto: the part is what does not touch the image border. light/dark: part lighter/darker than the bed. edges: by contours (material similar to the bed). adaptive: uneven light.
vision.long_straight_lines_length_and_angle: Long straight lines: length and angle of the material edge.
vision.point_corners_subpixel_to_aim_or: Point corners (subpixel) to aim or measure.
vision.holes_inside_the_part_center_diameter: Holes INSIDE the part: center, diameter, roundness.
vision.any_rectangle_4_sides_with_its: Any rectangle (4 sides) with its exact corners.
vision.material_outline_position_length_x_width: Material outline: position, length x width, rotation and shape.
vision.threshold_help: Grey level that separates part and bed. 0 = Otsu (computed automatically).
vision.not_calibrated_px_only: not calibrated: measurements in px only
vision.tap_the_vertices_the_first_closes: Tap the vertices; the first one closes
vision.head: Head
vision.page_cannot_reach_the_service: The page cannot reach the system's vision service (port {port}). If it was just installed or updated, wait a few seconds: it starts by itself. If it continues, check in Settings > Plugins that Vision (WorkshopVision) is started.
vision.could_not_confirm_the_change_with_v: Could not confirm the change with the Vision service: {v}
vision.file_is_not_valid_json: {file} is not valid JSON: it is not overwritten
vision.no_image_from_the_vision_service_port: No image from the vision service (port {port}). Check that the camera is on.
vision.marks_a_b_on_the_machine: Mark A on the machine: {a} · Mark B: {b}
vision.design_origin_result: Design origin (0,0) at X{x} Y{y} · rotation {ang}° · distance between marks {m} mm (in the design {d})
vision.difference_of_mm_check: Difference of {e} mm: check they are the right marks, the calibration or the design scale.
vision.rotation_applied: Rotation of {ang}° applied around the active zone's 0,0. Everything sent now comes out rotated, until Remove rotation (G69).
vision.before_photo_saved_time: Before photo saved ({time}). After the cut, tap Compare without moving the camera.
vision.mode_has_no_measured_cutting_area: the mode {mode} has no measured cutting area
vision.fast_to_look_and_aim_res: Fast to look and aim ({res}). To measure precisely use Measuring photo: the camera switches to 2048×1536 for a few seconds.
vision.bed_photo_saved_for_the_map_range: Bed photo saved for the map (X {x0} to {x1}, Y {y0} to {y1} mm). In Zones or 2D work, Bed photo layer.
vision.move_the_gantry_and_take_the_photos: Move the gantry and take the photos
vision.move_the_gantry_and_take_the_photo: Move the gantry and take the photo
vision.moves_the_gantry_to_each_position: Moves the gantry (raises Z first if it goes up; laser off) to each position and takes the photo. Asks for a second tap.
vision.go_back_afterwards: go back afterwards to where it was
vision.measuring_at_height: Measuring at {h} mm above the bed (the lens is at {lens} mm): measurements are scaled by x{f}. Set 0 for flat parts.
vision.nothing_found_hint: Nothing was found. Try another option in Detection settings (for example How to separate the part = edges) or mark a Zone on the image.
vision.brings_the_pointer_to_the_center: Brings the POINTER to the center (raises Z 5 mm, goes, lowers it; laser off). Asks for a second tap.
vision.opens_the_zone_editor_with_origin: Opens the zone editor with the {what} as origin (X/Y already loaded). You save it.
vision.uses_the_center_as_mark_k: Uses the center of this detection as mark {k} of the cut on marks.
vision.template_saved: Template "{name}" saved: all screens see it.
vision.report_downloaded_part_holes: Report downloaded: part {l} x {a} mm and {n} hole(s), measured from its bottom-left corner.
vision.cutting_area_saved: Cutting area of {mode} saved: X {x0} to {x1}, Y {y0} to {y1} ({m} mm inside the edge
vision.the_sheet_is_rotated_ang: ; the sheet is rotated {ang}°, it is the straight rectangle that fits inside it
vision.the_part_is_rotated_offcut: ; the part is rotated {ang}°, the offcut is the rectangle that contains it
vision.print_markers_hint: Print at 100 % (no fit to page). Each black marker is {mm} mm per side: measure it with a ruler after printing.
vision.sheet_of_size_pointer_off: Sheet of {w} × {h} mm. The pointer is off by {e} mm from the sheet (that is the error that matters: the one above gives 0 with 4 corners).
vision.the_pointer_is_off_by_mm_board: The pointer is off by {e} mm from the board
vision.there_is_a_saved_correction: There is a saved correction ({n} photos, error {e} px).
vision.photo_n_added_move_the_board: Photo {n} added. Move the board to another place and add another one.
vision.lens_calculated_with_n_photos: Lens calculated with {n} photos: error {e} px
vision.print_board_hint: Print at 100 % (no fit to page). Board of {cols} x {rows} squares of {mm} mm: measure a square with a ruler and enter it in Vision.
vision.lens_at_z_plus_crosses_fit: Lens at Z + {h} mm of the bed ({n} crosses, fit {e} mm)
vision.check_in_yz_crosses: Check at Y{y} Z{z}: {n} crosses, average error {e} mm (max {max})
vision.laser_crosses_help: Marks small crosses (6, 9 or 12) with the laser on a scrap sheet and finds them with the camera: nothing to print or aim. It MOVES the machine (Y/Z for the photos, the probe if it measures) and FIRES the laser at low power. It takes a few minutes. Before: scrap sheet in the area the macro measures and Laser mode.
vision.crosses_need_laser: Automatic calibration with laser crosses is only available when the machine uses Laser mode. Turn it on in Machine, Machine modes; meanwhile use ArUco markers, the A4 sheet or points by hand.
vision.height_the_lens_is_at_z_mm: Height: the lens is at Z + {h} mm of the bed
vision.fit_mm_photos_any_z: Fit {e} mm: photos can be taken at any Z.
vision.photo_size_at_yz_now_calibrate: Photo {size} at Y{y} Z{z}. Now calibrate (markers or points by hand).
vision.average_error_result: Average error {e} mm (worst {max} mm) · {ppm} px/mm · image {size}
vision.gantry_at_z_now_take_photo: Gantry at Z{z}. Now Take photo here.
vision.raises_lowers_the_gantry_to_that_z: Raises/lowers the gantry to that Z (machine coordinate; not below 40 mm). Asks for a second tap.
vision.lens_at_z_plus_in_this_photo: Lens at Z + {h} mm of the bed (in this photo: {lens} mm) · fit {e} mm
vision.warn_watch_off: Fire and smoke monitoring is turned off: it will not warn or pause even if it sees a flame.
vision.warn_action_warn: When it detects a flame it only warns: the job continues even if there is a fire.
vision.warn_action_pause: When it detects a flame it pauses the job after the countdown: a pause in the middle of a cut can leave a mark on the material.
vision.warn_action_emergency: When it detects a flame it does an emergency stop after the countdown: everything stops, the job is lost and you need to restart and home.
vision.warn_sensitivity_low: Low sensitivity: it needs a bigger flame and more time; it may miss a small fire.
vision.warn_sensitivity_high: High sensitivity: it warns sooner, but can be fooled by materials that glow while cutting.
vision.warn_flame_countdown_immediate: Immediate flame countdown: on seeing fire it acts at once, with no time to cancel.
vision.warn_flame_countdown_s: Flame countdown of {s} s: that is the time to cancel a false flame alarm.
vision.smoke_countdown_s_before_acting: Smoke countdown of {s} s before acting
vision.less_time_to_cancel_a_false_alarm: (less time to cancel a false alarm).
vision.countdown_help: Before pausing or cutting it shows a countdown at the top of every DWC screen and on this card, with a button to cancel. The flame (real fire) waits briefly: 2 s by default (choice: immediate, 2 or 3 s); smoke, which is more easily confused, waits 10 s. If the flame or smoke disappears during the countdown, it does nothing. Every detection, countdown, cancellation and pause is kept in the history below (with its photo).
vision.there_is_a_saved_change_list: There is a saved change that was not confirmed and will not apply until the job ends: {list}. It keeps what was set at the start of the job ({current}).
vision.flame_detected_countdown: FLAME detected: {action} in {n} s if it continues
vision.smoke_detected_countdown: SMOKE detected: {action} in {n} s if it continues
vision.live_camera_bring_the_flame: Live camera: bring the flame into view ({s} s)
vision.in_red_flame_in_violet_white: In red, what it sees as flame; in violet, the white that was already there.
vision.flame_test_result: {img} % of the image ({pct} % of the {thr} % threshold), the biggest spot {px} px. In red, what would count as flame
vision.laser_dot_in_light_blue: ; in light blue, the laser dot, which does not count
vision.to_warn_it_must_last: To warn it must stay like this for {s} s in a row.
vision.in_violet_very_bright_white: In violet: very bright white ({px} px, {pct} % of the threshold). This camera sees flames as white: while watching it counts as flame if it was NOT in the reference image (the first seconds); a reflection that was already there does not count.
vision.would_not_warn_now_because: Right now it would not warn even if it saw fire because {reasons}. To test without a job use Live test.
vision.saved_the_camera_is_on_the_v: Saved: the camera is on the {v}. Calibrate again in Calibrate (with photo) at two heights: the previous calibration was with the camera somewhere else.
vision.camera_source_help: By default the system relay (the same monitoring camera; one more client takes nothing from it). With a second camera, put its MJPEG stream here. The system reads it, not this browser.
vision.svg_comment_bottom_left_corner: bottom-left corner on the machine: X{x} Y{y}
vision.saved_as_part: Saved as "{name}" ({w} × {h} mm, {n} holes). Rename it in Saved parts.
vision.part_not_found_in_the_last_images: The part is not found in the last {n} images (covered, outside the image or it moved a lot).
vision.vision_service_not_answering_port: The Vision service on port {port} is not answering ({error}). Check in Settings > Plugins that Vision is started.
vision.workshop_vision_service_port: taller-vision service on the system, port {port}
vision.n_corners_found_outer_corners: {n} corners found. Outer corners: 1 to 4 in the image.
vision.uses_the_crosses_already_marked_date: Uses the crosses already marked (from {date}): only photos moving Y/Z, the laser does not fire. The sheet must not have moved.
vision.at_z_sees_x: At Z{z} it sees X {x0}…{x1} ({ppm} px/mm)
vision.direct_camera_without_relay: The image comes straight from the ESP32: the relay of the Pi does not answer. It runs at a few snapshots per second so the camera is not overloaded; it goes back to the relay by itself when it returns.
vision.camera_processing_running: The service is receiving the camera image now.
vision.camera_processing_resting: The service is not processing the camera now (no plugin that uses it is active).
vision.camera_processing_unknown: The state of the service is not known.
vision.camera_processing_help: Stopped, the service receives no frames, makes no timelapse and does not watch the camera, even if Vision, Camera or the Workbench are open. This same switch turns it back on.
vision.guided_calibration_tip: One path with the marker sheet, no technical parameters.
vision.guided_intro: Calibrate the camera in five steps with the marker sheet. Follow the steps in order.
vision.guided_step_sheet: Put the sheet with the markers
vision.guided_step_photo: Take the photo of the sheet
vision.guided_help_image: The camera has to show an image.
vision.guided_help_sheet: Put the sheet with the 4 markers on the bed, flat and in view, and leave the camera above it (machine still and axes homed).
vision.guided_help_photo: All 4 markers have to be seen in the photo.
vision.guided_help_calibrate: It is worked out from the markers and tells you if it came out well.
vision.guided_help_save: It is kept so the image measures in millimetres.
vision.guided_blocked_no_camera: The camera is not sending an image. Check that it is on and press Refresh.
vision.guided_blocked_no_marks: The positions of the markers are missing: a technician has to write them down in Calibrate > ArUco.
vision.guided_blocked_cannot_calibrate: Your user cannot calibrate the camera: ask a technician.
vision.guided_blocked_cannot_save: Your user cannot save the calibration: ask a technician.
vision.guided_seen_n: I see {n} of 4 markers. All 4 have to be seen: move the camera over the sheet and take the photo again.
vision.guided_quality_fair: It came out acceptable. You can save it.
vision.guided_quality_bad: It did not come out well. Take another photo of the sheet, flat and without shadows.
vision.roles_viewer: Your user can see the state but not use the vision. Ask an operator to do it.

startup_vision.config_tip: File 0:/sys/workshop/config/vision.json: calibrations, settings and templates. The first calibration creates it; this page never overwrites it.
startup_vision.config_new: does not exist yet (the first calibration creates it)
startup_vision.backend_tip: The vision program the plugin installs on the Pi (port 8095). If it does not answer: Settings > Plugins, make sure it is started.
startup_vision.camera_tip: The vision engine needs to see the camera. It is added and tested in the Camera plugin.
startup_vision.camera_wait: on standby or with a warning (open Detect to wake it)
startup_vision.calibration_tip: Without calibration the image cannot be turned into millimetres. Do it in Calibrate with a sheet, a board or by hand.
startup_vision.calibration_map: only the map one (not calibrated here yet)
startup_vision.macro_tip: Shipped by the plugin (0:/sys/workshop/macros/visionpose.g); it raises the gantry to take the measuring photo. If it is missing, reinstall the plugin.
startup_vision.macro_missing: The measuring photo cannot be taken. Reinstall the plugin: the macro comes with it.
startup_vision.config_what: The vision.json file, where calibrations, settings and templates are saved.
startup_vision.config_for: Vision reads and writes it; the page never overwrites it by itself.
startup_vision.config_missing: While it does not exist, Vision works with factory values; the first calibration creates it. If it shows as damaged, edit or delete it so it is rebuilt.
startup_vision.backend_what: The vision engine (OpenCV): the program on the Pi that analyses the image.
startup_vision.backend_missing: None of the vision features work. Check that it is started in Settings > Plugins.
startup_vision.camera_what: A camera with an image that the vision engine can see.
startup_vision.camera_for: Without an image there is nothing to measure.
startup_vision.camera_missing: Add it and test it in the Camera plugin.
startup_vision.calibration_what: The calibration turns the pixels of the image into real millimetres.
startup_vision.calibration_missing: Measurements come out in pixels, not in millimetres. Calibrate with a sheet, a board or by hand.
startup_vision.macro_what: The visionpose.g macro, which raises the gantry to take the measuring photo.

common.it_will_not_act_again_for: It will not act again for 60 s.

fireNotice.pausing_the_job_in_n_s: pausing the job in {n} s if it continues
fireNotice.emergency_stop_in_n_s: emergency stop in {n} s if it continues
